name: Dulverton Trust Conservation grants
summary: Grants to UK charities working on the health of UK wildlife habitat, mainly woodland and tree planting and management and coastal and marine protection. Applicants first take an eligibility quiz, then submit an expression of interest.

applicant_types.quote: We fund charities and CIOs with a national reach working within the above funding categories that meet our eligibility.

geography.quote: We support charities working on the health and resilience of the UK's wildlife habitat.

access.quote: To apply, complete our eligibility quiz (button below). If eligible, you will be provided with a link to our online Expression of Interest form.
